# 滑油燃油与附件

_Oil, Fuel & Accessory Systems_

燃油计量、润滑、冷却、点火和起动等系统支持发动机运行。FAA 教材提供这些系统的分章介绍，可按功能和接口逐步整理。

_Fuel metering, lubrication, cooling, ignition and starting systems support engine operation. The FAA handbook provides chapters that can be indexed by function and interface._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先画清系统功能、流路和与主机的接口。

_Map system functions, flow paths and interfaces with the engine first._

- 把压力、温度、污染物和维护记录与异常现象关联。

_Link pressure, temperature, contamination and maintenance records to observed symptoms._

- 比较资料前先核对发动机类型，避免把不同构型的系统安排混为一谈。

_Check engine configuration before comparing different system arrangements._

航空发动机、燃油、点火、润滑与维护等分章教材。

_A general textbook covering engines, fuel, ignition, lubrication and maintenance._
